# Qur’an — selected passages in the Quranic Arabic Corpus

## Identity, edition and scope

Selected interpretive witness: A. J. Arberry’s English rendering as displayed by the Quranic Arabic Corpus, with its Arabic ḥ-s-b concordance and parallel translations used to disclose translation differences. No particular Arberry printing or Qur’anic manuscript has been collated. Read all displayed translations for 17:12–15 and 7:180; use Arberry for the following bounded paraphrases. The surrounding suras and their compositional chronology are not audited. The Arabic comparative case has an independently dated ninth-century hadith carrier, not an invented date for these individual verses.

## Passages and excerpts

<a id="quran-arberry-corpus-selected-p001"></a>
### quran-arberry-corpus-selected-p001 — Signs and reckoning

**Paraphrase:** Night and day serve as signs through which years and reckoning become knowable. The adjacent sequence presents a personal book at resurrection, addresses its bearer as reader and reckoner, and distinguishes each person’s burden.

**Locator:** Qur’an 17:12–15; Arberry rows on the four verse pages; ḥ-s-b concordance at 17:12 and 17:14.

**Provenance:** Quranic Arabic Corpus verse pages and concordance, saved HTMLs. Read 2026-09-08 against the identified online witness.

**Source relation:** Paraphrased.

**Status:** paraphrase-ready; no quotation admitted.

**Use boundary:** The narrative’s divine reckoning is not a human revisable ledger. Verse 13’s bird-of-omen expression varies across translations; no single rendering silently settles its interpretation.

<a id="quran-arberry-corpus-selected-p002"></a>
### quran-arberry-corpus-selected-p002 — Names as invocation

**Paraphrase:** The Names belong to God and are used in invocation; the verse also concerns their misuse and its consequence.

**Locator:** Qur’an 7:180, Arberry row, with the other displayed translations compared.

**Provenance:** Quranic Arabic Corpus quran-7-180.html. Read 2026-09-08 against the identified online witness.

**Source relation:** Paraphrased.

**Status:** paraphrase-ready; no quotation admitted.

**Use boundary:** This verse gives no count of ninety-nine and no complete list. Invocation and later enumeration must retain their distinct textual carriers.
